acceptance_criteria: A valid producer retryAfterMs is never truncated below the producer's retry window.
A pre-provider rate-limit rejection does not consume repeated send attempts before its retry window opens.
Deferred rate-limited work survives restart with an explicit retry_not_before authority or an equivalently durable schedule.
Exhausted rate-limit deferral is classified as a definitive non-send rather than maybe_sent.
Invalid, zero, negative, excessive, and shutdown-crossing retry hints have bounded fail-closed behavior with focused tests.
blast_radius: Signal and future transport rate limits, agent outbound latency, retry budgets, durable queue recovery, shutdown behavior, duplicate risk, delivery-state truth, and operator telemetry.
evidence_summary: Three prior stable reads plus the retry read pinned the open identity, five labels, timestamp, URL, and body hash while remote main remained de3f69bbb5648b804ea2843d310c47dda544a056. Exact-main Signal source computes a retryAfterMs from its 60-second per-conversation window, and the transport error contract preserves that value, but OutboundQueue clamps every positive hint to its generic 8-second backoff ceiling. The queue then consumes its fixed attempts and records non-governor exhaustion as maybe_sent even though the local limiter rejected before adapter delivery. Exact-main durability has no retry_not_before or equivalent deferred-work field. An existing test explicitly requires a 999,999 ms producer hint to become 8,000 ms. The decisive application and test paths are byte-equal between exact main and the audit branch, and a supporting focused run passed 525 of 525 tests across nine files. A fully paginated stable-main capture covered 37 open pull requests, 27 drafts, and all 1,402 declared file occurrences. Draft PR #2451 partially coordinates taxonomy but does not own retry behavior; PRs #2456 and #2488 are path collisions, and no implementation owner exists. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding would be falsified if producer windows were preserved through durable deferral without premature attempts and a pre-provider rate-limit exhaustion settled as a definitive non-send. Exact-main source and its clamp test prove the opposite. Restart and shutdown fault injection remains an implementation-time obligation.
impact: A producer can require a wait far beyond eight seconds, yet the consumer retries early, burns all attempts inside the closed window, and records false delivery ambiguity for work that never reached the provider.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2557 and remote main immediately before integration; reject any changed identity, labels, timestamp, URL, or body hash.

Add RED and GREEN tests for a 60-second Signal window, multiple consecutive limits, restart, shutdown, invalid hints, and failed_permanent versus maybe_sent.
Re-scan all open pull requests and establish one implementation owner while coordinating issues #2553, #2555, and #2558.
